title: MWS 3-year resurvey — Reproductive/Hormonal
description: Menopausal hormone treatment (HRT) and menopause status recorded at the 3-year resurvey.

F1HRTSTA.title: Age started HRT
F1HRTSTA.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (F1HTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
F1HRTSTA.$comment: null branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F1HTNPC -- D052. Bound removed entirely -- source states no range for this field; the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).

F1HTTYPE.title: Type of HRT
F1HTTYPE.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (F1HTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
F1HTTYPE.$comment: Same code list as recruitment's RHTTYPE. null branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F1HTNPC -- D052.

F1HTNPC.title: HRT use: never/past/current/status not known
F1HTNPC.$comment: Source coding: 1 Never; 2 Past; 3 Current; 4 'Ever, status NK' [source wording]. A 4th level not present in recruitment's RHTNPC (which only had 1-3) -- deliberately NOT wired into either the Never-gate skip or the ever-used applicability rule below, same open-question treatment as ROOPH=3 in the recruitment table (D030); steward confirmed this stays unconstrained -- D052.

F1HTDUR.title: Total duration of HRT use
F1HTDUR.x-universe: Participants who have ever used HRT (F1HTNPC=2 Past or 3 Current).
F1HTDUR.$comment: Source states no valid range; 0-50 agent-decided, matching recruitment's RHTDUR -- D051. null branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F1HTNPC -- D052.

F1HTLU.title: Time since HRT last used
F1HTLU.x-universe: Participants who used HRT in the past but have stopped (F1HTNPC=2 Past only) -- someone currently using has no 'last used' age, same reasoning as recruitment's RHTLU.
F1HTLU.$comment: Source states valid range 0-40 (recruitment's RHTLU had no stated range at all -- this one is source-stated). null branch enforced by a mother-file skip pair keyed on F1HTNPC -- D052.

F1MENO.title: Menopause yet

oneOf.title: Not sure (because periods irregular, taking HRT etc)

F1MENO.$comment: Source's own code list includes -1=Not on questionnaire for this field. null added alongside per D020. Not the same question as recruitment's RPSTOPYN ('periods stopped now') -- this asks about menopause specifically, a related but distinct concept, so kept as its own field rather than merged.

F1MENOAG.title: Age at menopause
F1MENOAG.x-universe: Not restricted to F1MENO=1 -- steward confirmed participants answering F1MENO=3 (Not sure) may still report an age, so no skip pair against F1MENO is warranted (D053, resolved).
F1MENOAG.$comment: Source's own codes: -1='Not asked on questionnaire' (mapped to the shared not_on_questionnaire sentinel), 77='Turners syndrome/Never had periods' (a real substantive answer, not a missingness sentinel -- kept as its own const branch, not mapped onto null), 99='Unknown (tick/?/varies etc)' (source's own field-specific unknown code, kept as its own const branch rather than mapped onto the shared null). null added alongside anyway per D020, for any gap none of these three cover. Numeric range No skip pair against F1MENO -- steward confirmed this is correct, D053 resolved. Bound removed entirely -- source states no range for this field; the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104).
